findings.summary: delivery.md (requirement->implementation->test mapping, precise HEAD/PR/dependency config, and a ready_for_joint_validation statement explicitly recording that joint run, integration, deployment and E2E are not yet executed) is not present in the product tree. It belongs to the final-delivery envelope ahead of the merge stage and must be produced before final delivery; the L1-L7 functional work, contract tests and recorded acceptance are otherwise complete.
